tools.watchdog.title: Thermal watchdog
tools.watchdog.desc:
Watches GPU/CPU and steps the CPU cap down if it heats up.
When stopped it restores your previous configuration.
tools.monitor.title: Monitor with CSV log
tools.monitor.desc:
Records a CSV every second into logs/ (useful for game sessions).
Launches in its own console window.
tools.session.title: Game session (overlay + CSV + HTML report)
tools.session.desc:
Click-through overlay with temps, RAM, VRAM and free commit.
In-game hotkeys:  Shift+Z hide · Shift+M marker · Ctrl+Shift+Q end.
On exit it writes logs/reporte_<date>.html and the CSV.
tools.mem.title: RAM memory — Mem Reduct
tools.mem.desc:
Cleans RAM cache/standby with Mem Reduct (Native API). Auto-clean only kicks in when free RAM drops,
to avoid trimming too much and causing stutters in game.
tools.mem.notfound: ⚠ memreduct.exe not found. Install it (winget install Henry++.MemReduct) or put it in tools/MemReduct/.
tools.aviso.title: Thermal throttling alert
tools.aviso.desc:
Watches CPU and GPU with your own thresholds. If exceeded, it gives 3 alerts (Windows toast + pop-up) ~15 s apart.
With “Protect” on, if the temperature does NOT drop after the alerts, it throttles the CPU in steps to cool down — it NEVER shuts down the PC. Stopping it restores your CPU ceiling.
tools.aviso.protect: Protect (throttle CPU if it stays hot)
